Success.title: Success
Success.description: True if AGENT_CreateContact created the Contact successfully.

CreatedContactId.title: CreatedContactId
CreatedContactId.description: Salesforce ID of the newly created Contact. Populated only when Success is true.

CreatedContactName.title: CreatedContactName
CreatedContactName.description: Full name of the newly created Contact. Populated only when Success is true.

DuplicateFound.title: DuplicateFound
DuplicateFound.description: True if AGENT_CreateContact found a potential duplicate and did not create a Contact.

DuplicateContactName.title: DuplicateContactName
DuplicateContactName.description: Name of the potential duplicate Contact, populated when DuplicateFound is true.

DuplicateContactId.title: DuplicateContactId
DuplicateContactId.description: Salesforce ID of the potential duplicate Contact, populated when DuplicateFound is true.

ErrorMessage.title: ErrorMessage
ErrorMessage.description: Error message returned by AGENT_CreateContact when Success is false.
